name: @dendro-x0/deco-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Deco: Disk Cleanup for Developers

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @dendro-x0/deco-cli exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -F @dendro-x0/deco-frontend exec tsc -b --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:all
scripts.icons:generate: python scripts/generate-deco-icon.py && pnpm -F @dendro-x0/deco-desktop exec tauri icon src-tauri/icons/app-icon.png
